set.tovw: Lead grade B (treasure thread): two independent 1903 papers put $8,000-10,000 still unfound at the Mill St home; house placed to the street end, no lot

tw-mn-fergus-falls-trombler-1903.t: The $8,000-10,000 is the heirs' arithmetic from pension receipts, not a count; whether the administrator's later search found it is the open question (Otter Tail probate file).
